noAccess.title: You don't have access to this page
noAccess.body: Ask an administrator to grant you the permission {{permission}}.

banner.disabled: Lead Generation is switched off for the platform right now.
banner.providerMissing: Business search isn't configured on this platform yet, so new searches can't run.

overview.title: Lead Generation overview
overview.description: See what your searches, outreach and credits are producing.
overview.emptyBody: Run your first search to find businesses that match who you sell to.
overview.bounceHint: Keep this under 3% to protect your mailbox.
overview.sourcesHint: Cost per reply for each search, so you know where to spend next.

find.title: Find leads
find.description: Search real businesses by area and type. Finding them is free — you only pay credits to reveal contact details.
find.noSearchesBody: Start one to see matching businesses appear here.
find.noCreate: You can view searches but not start new ones.
find.name: Search name
find.nameHint: Optional — we'll name it from your choices.
find.estimateEmpty: Choose a region and a business type to see an estimate.
find.estimateFree: Finding is free. You have {{left}} searches left today; revealing a contact costs {{cost}} credit(s).
find.profileHint: Fill in your targeting profile so results are scored for fit.
find.deleteBody: Prospects you haven't revealed are removed with it. Revealed contacts stay in your list.

prospects.title: Prospects
prospects.description: Every business your searches found. Reveal the ones worth contacting, then add them to a campaign or your CRM.
prospects.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, area or category…
prospects.emptyBody: Run a search, add a business by hand, or loosen the filters.
prospects.addManualHint: Add one you already know about. It's yours to keep — no credits needed.
prospects.notOperational: This business may be closed or moved.
prospects.suppressedBanner: This contact is on your do-not-contact list. You can't email them.
prospects.lockedBody: Phone: {{phone}} · Website: {{site}}. Reveal to see the details.
prospects.revealPolicy: If no usable contact is found you're refunded. A verified email earns {{bonus}} credit(s) back.
prospects.deleteBody: This removes them from your list. Credits already spent are not refunded.
prospects.needContact: Reveal first — you need a contact to continue.
prospects.fitHint: How well it matches who you sell to.
prospects.qualityHint: How complete and reliable its data is.

reveal.title: Reveal {{count}} contact(s)
reveal.costHint: {{base}} credits, up to {{extra}} more if we find extra contacts.
reveal.rule2: A verified email earns {{bonus}} credit(s) back.
reveal.rule3: Nothing usable found? You're refunded automatically.
reveal.rule4: An email that bounces within {{days}} days is refunded too.
reveal.notEnough: You don't have enough credits for all of them.
reveal.partial: You can reveal {{count}} with your balance.
reveal.ranOut: Stopped: ran out of credits for {{count}}.
reveal.refundNote: {{count}} refunded because no usable contact was found.

addToCampaign.title: Add {{count}} to a campaign
addToCampaign.rules: Only revealed contacts with a verified, non-suppressed email are added.

assign.title: Assign {{count}}
assign.hint: The assignee will see these in their prospects list.

picker.title: Add prospects
picker.subtitle: Only revealed contacts with a sendable email are shown.
picker.empty: No eligible prospects. Reveal some first.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.description: Send a sequence of emails from your own mailbox and stop automatically when someone replies.
campaigns.emptyBody: Write your emails once and send them to the prospects you've revealed.
campaigns.needMailbox: Connect a mailbox before you can send a campaign.
campaigns.deleteBody: The campaign and its history are removed. Replies stay in your inbox.
campaigns.draftHint: Add recipients, check the preview, then start.
campaigns.stopBody: No more emails will be sent. You can't restart a stopped campaign.

builder.name: Campaign name
builder.mailboxHint: Replies come back to this mailbox.
builder.noMailbox: You need a connected mailbox first.
builder.windowError: The end time must be after the start time.
builder.stopOnReplyHint: Recommended. Follow-ups never go to someone who already answered.
builder.firstEmail: Sent as soon as the campaign starts.
builder.subject: Subject
builder.mergeHint: Click to insert a merge field:
builder.footerNote: An unsubscribe link and your business address are added to every email automatically.

preview.title: Preview — email {{n}}
preview.subtitle: Shown with a real prospect's details.
preview.subject: Subject
preview.testHint: Sends this email to an address you choose.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: Replies from your prospects, in one place.
inbox.label: Label
inbox.emptyBody: When a prospect answers one of your emails it appears here.
inbox.pickBody: Pick a reply on the left to read and answer it.
inbox.noMailbox: Connect a mailbox to receive replies.
inbox.cannotReply: This conversation can't be replied to.
inbox.unsubscribeNote: This person asked to unsubscribe. They were added to your do-not-contact list.

mailboxes.title: Mailboxes
mailboxes.description: Connect the address you send from. Emails go out through your own account.
mailboxes.why: Sending from your own mailbox keeps your emails trustworthy and replies in your hands. New mailboxes warm up slowly to protect your reputation.
mailboxes.emptyBody: Connect Google, Microsoft or any SMTP/IMAP account to start sending.
mailboxes.warmup: Warming up: day {{day}}, limit {{limit}} per day
mailboxes.disconnectBody: Campaigns using it will pause. Past messages stay in your inbox.
mailboxes.oauthMissing: {{provider}} sign-in isn't set up on this platform yet. Use SMTP / IMAP instead.

oauthBody.google: Sign in with Google and allow VRODUX to send and read mail for this address.
oauthBody.microsoft: Sign in with Microsoft and allow VRODUX to send and read mail for this address.

mailboxes.oauthPermissions: We only use this to send your campaign emails and detect replies and bounces.
mailboxes.zohoNote: For Zoho, create an app password in Account → Security and use it below.
mailboxes.appPasswordNote: This provider needs an app password, not your normal sign-in password.
mailboxes.displayNameHint: Shown to the people you email.
mailboxes.usernameHint: Usually the same as the address.
mailboxes.passwordHint: An app password if your provider requires one.
mailboxes.stored: Your password is encrypted and never shown again.
mailboxes.dailyLimitHint: The lower of this and the warm-up limit applies.
mailboxes.testHint: Use an address you can check.

credits.title: Credits
credits.description: Credits pay for revealing contact details. Finding businesses is free.
credits.refundHint: Returned when no usable contact was found or an email bounced.
credits.howItWorks: A reveal costs {{cost}} credit(s). A verified email earns {{bonus}} back. Nothing usable found means a full refund.
credits.paymentsOff: Online payments aren't switched on yet. Contact support to top up.
credits.cancelled: Payment cancelled. You haven't been charged.
credits.alertHint: We'll notify you when your balance drops to this number.
credits.trialGranted: Your free starter credits have been added.
credits.buyMovedBody: All add-on credits are now bought in one place, Settings → Billing → Add-ons & credits, with the price per credit shown for each module. Your balance here updates as soon as the payment is confirmed.
credits.askBillingAdmin: Ask a billing administrator to buy credits.

settings.title: Lead Generation settings
settings.description: Tell us who you sell to, who you are, and who you must never contact.
settings.targetBody: We use this to score each business for fit and to suggest better searches.
settings.excludeHint: Businesses whose name contains these are scored lower.
settings.categoriesHint: Pick the ones you sell to most.
settings.senderBody: Required by law and by inbox providers. It appears in the footer of every email you send.
settings.senderRequired: Add your business name and address before sending campaigns.
settings.dncBody: People and companies here are never emailed. Unsubscribes and bounces are added automatically.
settings.dncEmptyBody: Add an email, a whole domain or a phone number.
settings.importHint: Paste emails, domains or phone numbers separated by spaces, commas or new lines.

admin.title: Lead Generation — platform
admin.description: Packs, limits and usage across all workspaces.
admin.pool: Shared business pool: {{size}} businesses, {{enriched}} with details.
admin.grantAmountHint: Use a negative number to remove credits.

setting.enabledHint: Turn off to stop all searches and sending.
setting.requireSenderIdentityHint: Name and address must be set before sending.
setting.blockSendingOnTrialHint: Trial workspaces can search but not email.
setting.verifiedEmailBonusHint: Credits returned for a verified email.
setting.bounceRefundDaysHint: Bounces inside this window are refunded.
setting.allowedCountriesHint: Country codes, comma separated (e.g. AE, SA).

admin.packsMovedBody: Credits are now priced per credit, for every module, in Credit pricing. The old fixed packs are no longer sold.
